scope: Conditional22-window reward-supply ledger for an already-unlocked Lv60 account feeding one newly owned Lv1 four-star on the bench. Actual combat was NOT played: live legal Lv60 blossom entries are followed by an explicitly injected zero-enemy-HP victory settlement fixture. Native USE_ITEM, CHAR_ASCEND, native exact current material/Mora payment, cap limits, shared once-kind-per-hour claim, reward and duplicate-settlement behavior are executed. No production code overrides, no new mixed-party victory assertion, no claim of guaranteed22h/48h farming or new-player unlock time. Ownership/story gates, old-party gear/initial funding, exact ascension materials and excluded blossom travel location are declared synthetic inputs. Only the old60 party participates: the new character receives no participant400XP but DOES receive the existing25% bench sharing100XP per settlement, with native cap discard separately recorded.
